mapper.sql: t.id,t.template_code,t.category_id,c.name category_name,t.name,t.description,t.image_url, t.image_source_url,t.image_author,t.image_license,t.reference_price,t.taste_tags,t.meal_tags, t.sort_order,t.enabled,(d.id is not null) imported, (select count(*) from dish_template_ingredients ti where ti.template_id=t.id) ingredient_count
t.enabled=1 and t.category_id=#{categoryId} and t.name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') and d.id is not null and d.id is null
mapper.select: select id,code,name,sort_order,enabled from dish_template_categories where enabled=1 order by sort_order,id

select from dish_templates t join dish_template_categories c on c.id=t.category_id and c.enabled=1 left join dishes d on d.source_template_id=t.id and d.merchant_id = #{merchantId} where t.id=#{templateId} and t.enabled=1
select id,template_id,ingredient_name,ingredient_category,quantity,unit,calc_type,sort_order from dish_template_ingredients where template_id=#{templateId} order by sort_order,id

select t.id,t.template_code,t.category_id,c.name category_name,t.name,t.description,t.image_url, t.image_source_url,t.image_author,t.image_license,t.reference_price,t.taste_tags,t.meal_tags, t.sort_order,t.enabled,false imported,0 ingredient_count from dish_templates t join dish_template_categories c on c.id=t.category_id and c.enabled=1 where t.enabled=1 and t.id in #{id} order by t.id

select t.id,t.template_code,t.category_id,c.name category_name,t.name,t.description,t.image_url, t.image_source_url,t.image_author,t.image_license,t.reference_price,t.taste_tags,t.meal_tags, t.sort_order,t.enabled,false imported,0 ingredient_count from dish_templates t join dish_template_categories c on c.id=t.category_id and c.enabled=1 where t.enabled=1 order by c.sort_order,t.sort_order,t.id
select id,template_id,ingredient_name,ingredient_category,quantity,unit,calc_type,sort_order from dish_template_ingredients where template_id in #{id} order by template_id,sort_order,id
select source_template_id from dishes d where d.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and source_template_id in #{id}
select id,merchant_id merchantId,name,sort_order sortOrder,enabled from dish_categories where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and name=#{name} limit 1
select id from dishes where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and source_template_id=#{templateId} limit 1
